en.html:
The waitress herself apparently felt no such mismatch. A young woman whose expressions were more attractive than her features, I judged. With a perfect professional smile, she led us to a table.

Beside the window. A good view, for whatever use that was now. Being far from the kitchen mattered more. Keep our voices low, and we need not fear being overheard.

I sat down on a well-kept chair.

稲田"Really, sir. With such a sweet companion beside you?"
Kageaki"At present, you are the one who interests me."
Ichijou"Mi-na-to-sir!?"
稲田"Saying such things... Please stop teasing."
Kageaki"I am quite serious."
Ichijou"WHY!?"
稲田"...A difficult customer."
Kageaki"I too am in difficulty. To meet someone like you in a place like this."
Ichijou"Hello? My difficulty is also right here!"
稲田"Sir... why?"
Kageaki"Three things. Your hands, your legs, your eyes."
Ichijou"Only the body! No, wait—that is not even the problem!"
稲田"You say that to everyone, surely?"
Kageaki"No. To you alone..."
Ichijou"Since when is this your personality!? Or was it always? Dhokha ho gaya—I've been betrayed! And of all the ways, THIS is how!?"
Kageaki"Your hand... white, beautiful."
Kageaki"And now... very cold."
稲田"Will you tell me cold hands mean a warm heart?"
Kageaki"Folk beliefs do not interest me. This hand of yours—"
Ichijou"She has simply been washing dishes!"
稲田"Yes. We are short-staffed, so I help with everything, from washing dishes to preparing the food and drinks."
Kageaki"So I see. Kitchen work as well as serving customers."
Kageaki"And yet these hands are not rough at all. White, beautiful, smooth. Instead, a thin callus at the base of the fingers."
Kageaki"Something peculiar to those who have trained with a sword."
